assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Seven conditional occurrences with no inferred unlock level and no chronology across them; the reading forbids treating source order as a reform sequence. No default state is designated, and no state before or after these occurrences is assessed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The reading's cumulative finding is attention that is generous in valuation and self-serving in use: an objection to ranking peers' photographs (C:P3), a refusal to wear Haru's costume (E:P5) and a stated quality standard for her comic (D:P1-P2) sit beside an admitted advice pretext (B:P1-P2) and the conversion of general advice into a claimed endorsement (D:P3-P4). The cross-case pattern is sharper than a single trait, so it is graded; each address is three to five pages and no conditional rule is derived, so D is not supported.

The reading affirmatively forbids reading the seven occurrences as reform or as one calendar, and keeps F's book and G's manga, and C's and E's shopping, as separate occasions. Earlier Yumeno states (B0093-B0202) are context only and not enrolled.

A few phrases are located: accepting the old-man-inside joke (B:P3), flowers in both hands and ascension as appraisals (E), super maid-advisor (E:P3-P4), the claimed manager-approved plan (D:P4) and the self-repair from appreciating to watching the competition (G:P5). Otherwise her Japanese is paraphrased and the 31 voice cues were not heard.

Ordinary activities are reported, not shown: shopping for booklets in Akiba Seven (C), buying cloth with Rishuri and Ayumu (E), a rainy day at home with a borrowed book (F), reading a manga until dawn and oversleeping (G), and an unfinished comic for a manga-club bulletin (D). No routine is enacted.

Yumeno is the sole named speaking actor in all 31 records; the manager's compliments, advice and looks reach the reader only through her uptake, and Rishuri, Ayumu, Kazumi, Rena, Kyoko, Honoka and Haru never speak. One located differentiation (Haru's costume as hers alone, E:P5) does not support recipient conditioning.

Interior states are spoken self-reports, including an unusually direct admission of a concealed motive behind her advice role (B:P1-P2), dissatisfaction with her comic ideas (D:P1) and regret at the missed meet (G). No inward narration is distinguished from speech, and the reading does not supply her inner account in others' testimony.

Only brief, local friction is analyzed: she objects to what she reads as the manager's suspicious look and offers Kazumi as corroboration (F:P2-P3), briefly challenges his compliment (A:P3) and objects to the shop's ranking (C:P3). No escalation, sustained dispute or another person's resistance is shown.

Two stated value judgments are located: equal cuteness makes ranking unacceptable (C:P3) and Haru's exclusive costume is unthinkable for her to wear (E:P5). The reading treats both as local, and analyzes her pretext (B) and claimed endorsement (D) as appropriation without peer assent. That supports bounded canon questions about stated values, not a deliberation process.

The reading analyzes joking explicitly: suggestive amusement and a limited joking allowance (A:P2-P3), acceptance of the old-man-inside remark (B:P3), comic fitness claims (B:P4-P5) and extravagant appraisal language (E). It denies that the joking allowance transfers permission over others.

The family is complete: seven occurrences with exact scripts and hashes, all 38 native page states and 31 records read, one composite and three backgrounds viewed, and 155 context rows compared. It is still seven short addresses; the earlier readings, which the reading cites for pressure and refusal, are not enrolled, and no performed audio was reviewed.

Affirmative limits are located: the peers' assent is never supplied in A, B, D or G; the manager has no line endorsing D's plan; she cannot find a satisfying comic idea (D:P1); and she oversleeps and misses Rena's meet (G:P1-P2). The reading states that none of the independent cases is reform.
The reading establishes that no chronology, calendar or unlock level orders the occurrences, and that the meet in G is not identifiable with any earlier Rena episode.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any of the seven unordered occurrences; nothing before or after them.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: The manager, as the portfolio describes him; the refusal applies equally to peers and any other counterpart.
setting_constraints: Crossover, counterfactual or materially novel contexts beyond the seven located occurrences
Behavioral or dialogue simulation rather than bounded canon description

scenario_readiness.note: Seven short unordered addresses to one main interlocutor, with no conditional rules and the most relevant resistant evidence not enrolled, cannot support a novel context.
Reported shopping, reading and outings answer bounded canon questions, but give no procedure for an unfamiliar ordinary situation, and peers never respond.
Two local value statements and analyzed appropriation do not give a reasoning procedure; the reading forbids generalizing either into universal respect for boundaries.

Her attraction to peers is analyzed, but no participant's assent or response is supplied, and A's allowance about herself is limited and not a mutual romance. Simulation would have to invent other people's consent.
An unfinished comic for a club bulletin and a planned doujin costume appear in her reports; no idol work, completed manuscript or event is shown.

known_limits.statement: The seven sources are conditional occurrences with no chronology or unlock level; source order cannot make any address a reform or relapse, and separate occasions must not be merged.
Yumeno is the only speaking actor in all 31 records; the manager's words and every peer's activities are known only through her account.

No peer gives assent to the attention, advice use or planned contact Yumeno describes; her equal admiration and the joking allowance about herself confer no permission over others, and none may be supplied in generation.
The manager-approved plan in 401000834 is her conversion of general advice; the manager has no line endorsing it.
No performed voice, laughter, music or continuous runtime was heard or watched; the reused enthusiastic sprite does not certify line-specific reactions.

The earlier Yumeno readings (B0093, B0131, B0168, B0169, B0174, B0183, B0202), which the reading cites for pressure, refusal and recording objection, are not curated on this subject and were not checked. The assessed set is therefore not the full resistant record, and missing support is not evidence of absence.
Apart from a few located phrases, the reading paraphrases Yumeno's Japanese, so self-reference, sentence endings and register shifts are not in the curated evidence.
